field_changes.old:
We've spent this release fine-tuning things behind the scenes so Centr stays fast and reliable while you train. A small polish to the meditation player is along for the ride, as well as a fix for your music and podcasts playing during your workouts.

Questions, feedback, or need help? We're here: hello@centr.com.
field_changes.new:
This release includes fixes to make your workouts smoother, including coaching audio that now stops when your workout ends and clearer messages when casting to your TV.

Need a hand or have feedback? Reach our team anytime at hello@centr.com.
